verdict.rationale: Adyen supports some domain-specific event-triggered automation. You can configure your own monitoring rules and mitigations for user risk, pre-choose how chargeback events are handled, and set up managed payout schedules that run automatically. Webhooks push events to your endpoint, but any custom action on those events has to be built in your own code. missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined rule/trigger-action engine across event types, documentation of rule configuration syntax or UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
